text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Phew. I finished my prayers for our first shrine visit of the year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I have set just one goal for this year: conquering the spring Tenno Sho.
choice_data_list: It's time to show the world how hard you've worked.
It's time to show the world how hard you've worked.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. I've definitely grown stronger in the time I've spent with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: All that remains now is to transform my hard work into real results. I shall win without fail.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Incidentally, what should we do when we return to the academy today?
choice_data_list: It's the start of the new year, so let's relax.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You're right. Being impatient now would do more harm than good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I must maintain composure in light of this tremendous goal I have set.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Let's relax today so we may start off the new year fresh and with presence of mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Our usual… Yes, that's quite important.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We must commit ourselves to a steady routine to avoid falling complacent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Since it's the beginning of the year, I must take care not to forget my resolution.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My, aren't we in a festive mood?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Even so, I admit I'm a little intrigued by—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ahem. I suppose there's no point in trying to convince you otherwise. Very well. If that's what you wish, I shall accompany you.
